prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: TRANSPARENT cutout LEG RIG COMPONENTS for original pixel-art ASH HARBOR fighter. This is NOT a walking atlas and NOT full characters. Reference1 male and reference2 female are costume/palette references only.
Create exactly1536x512 transparent PNG, SIX COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, twelve equal256x256cells. Each cell contains ONE SEPARATED clothing/boot part centered with generous transparent padding. No connecting body parts between cells, no extra objects, no words, no labels or gridlines. Crisp authentic detailed 1990s pixel art with sharp dark pixel outlines, no soft 3D or antialiasing. Each component is built in a straight NEUTRAL VERTICAL position for later joint animation. All backgrounds truly transparent.
ROW1 male 陆炎, matching charcoal baggy pants and dark brass-trim boots from reference1:
cell1 NEAR upper leg/thigh only, from round hip socket top to round knee socket bottom; vertical, approx80x120source pixels; lighter warm charcoal fabric, baggy martial-arts folds, dark outer outline, covered round endcaps so it can overlap joints.
cell2 NEAR lower leg/shin only, from round knee top to round ankle bottom; straight vertical approx56x112; charcoal trouser folds at top, narrow dark boot shaft with a restrained antique brass cuff toward bottom, rounded overlap caps.
cell3 NEAR boot FOOT only, side-on toe pointing RIGHT, heel to LEFT, approx88x44source pixels; dark boot leather, readable bronze toe highlight and sole, ankle opening at upper left third; no shin.
cell4 FAR upper thigh, same shape/dimensions as cell1 but distinctly darker cool indigo charcoal fabric and fewer highlights; vertical straight.
cell5 FAR shin/boot shaft, matching cell2 but clearly darker cool shading, same straight vertical structure.
cell6 FAR boot FOOT, matching cell3, toe points RIGHT, darker shading.
ROW2 female 霁岚, matching ivory loose trousers and tall navy boots with gold trim from reference2:
cell1 NEAR upper thigh only, vertical neutral, ivory fabric with warm cream folds and dark outline, round overlap ends, approx80x120.
cell2 NEAR lower leg/shin only, vertical neutral, ivory knee fabric at top transitioning into tall dark navy boot shaft with a slim brass rim, approx56x112, rounded overlap ends.
cell3 NEAR boot FOOT only, dark navy, bronze sole/toe highlights, toe RIGHT, approx88x44, ankle opening at upper left third.
cell4 FAR upper thigh, matching row2 cell1 with distinctly darker muted grey-ivory shading.
cell5 FAR shin/boot shaft, matching row2 cell2 with darker shading.
cell6 FAR boot FOOT, matching row2 cell3 with darker shading, toe RIGHT.
Every part isolated. No heads, torsos, arms, hands, pelvis, complete legs or complete people. Make the parts usable for layered sprite animation, not a presentation image.
assembly: tools/build_walk.py: independent near/far thigh, shin and boot; fixed 27/25px bones; near and far legs offset by half cycle; original guard torso; eight 96x128 rasterized frames per actor
purpose: Pose reference only; not used by runtime resource build
